items.title: FortiMail zero-day under active attack: unauthenticated file write (CVE-2026-104286)
items.summary: Fortinet confirmed active exploitation of a critical 9.8-rated path-traversal/NULL-byte chaining flaw in FortiMail that lets unauthenticated attackers write files anywhere the service can reach; CISA added it to the KEV catalog on Oct 1 with a federal patch deadline of Oct 4. Patching alone doesn't evict footholds already planted, so internet-facing appliances need forensic triage.

items.title: WordPress core LFI flaw exploited within hours of patch (CVE-2026-87902)
items.summary: A 9.2-rated unauthenticated local-file-inclusion bug in get_page_template() affects WordPress 4.7.0 through 7.1.1 and was being probed in the wild almost immediately after WordPress shipped fixes on Sep 22; it can expose configs and credentials and enable remote code execution on some setups.

items.title: Cisco Secure Firewall flaw under active attack forces emergency updates (CVE-2026-20349)
items.summary: CISA-listed CVE-2026-20349 lets unauthenticated attackers crash Cisco ASA and Firepower Threat Defense appliances via crafted requests to the Remote Access SSL VPN service, knocking firewalls and VPNs offline; Cisco released patches with no available workarounds.

items.title: Australian volunteer emergency service Mandurah SES hit by TheGentlemen ransomware
items.summary: The Mandurah State Emergency Service, a volunteer rescue organization in Western Australia, was reportedly struck by the TheGentlemen ransomware group, raising concern about its ability to keep 24/7 rescue and cadet-support operations running; the full scope and data-theft details are not yet confirmed.

items.title: AI-discovered auth bypass in Rejetto HFS exploited within 24 hours of disclosure
items.summary: Anthropic's Mythos model found CVE-2026-61500, a critical 9.8 authentication-bypass flaw in Rejetto HFS, by reversing a PRNG with an SMT solver; VulnCheck observed in-the-wild exploitation the day after disclosure, hitting canary hosts in the US and Japan from Chinese infrastructure.
